info.title: corej CDISC Validation API
info.description: Session-oriented REST API over the corej CDISC validation engine: create a session, upload study files, start a check run, poll its status, and page through findings.

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: Upload sessions and their staged files

tags.name: checks
tags.description: Validation runs over a session's files

get.description: Returns a summary of every live session, most recently created first.

post.description: Optionally names the session via a JSON body { name }; an empty body creates an unnamed session.

post.summary: Stage a file into a session
post.description: Uploads one file under the given bare filename. The filename must not carry a path component, and a name may be uploaded at most once per session.

400.description: Filename missing or carries a path

delete.summary: Delete all staged files from a session
delete.description: Removes every staged file but keeps the (empty) session. Rejected (409) while any of the session's check runs are PENDING or RUNNING.

post.summary: Stage a file into a session by URL
post.description: The server downloads the http/https URL into the session under the given bare filename (derived from the URL path when omitted). Bounded by corej.sessions.max-download-bytes and corej.sessions.download-timeout; the JVM's global proxy system properties apply. A name may be staged at most once per session.

post.summary: Start a check run for a session
post.description: Queues a validation run over the session's staged files; returns immediately.
Pulls a queued run before it starts; signals a running run to abort cleanly.

delete.summary: Delete a session and its staged files
delete.description: Rejected (409) while any of the session's check runs are PENDING or RUNNING.

patch.description: Sets or clears (blank/null) the session's display name. Not gated by in-flight runs — it touches only metadata.

get.summary: Detect the Define-XML version of a staged file
get.description: Parses the named file and reports the detected Define-XML version (1.0 / 2.0 / 2.1) from its content. Both response fields are null when the file is not a recognisable Define-XML document. The web UI calls this when a define.xml is selected to pre-fill the define-version field.

get.summary: Valid values for the run form
get.description: The selectable rule PACKAGES (short names, each with the CDISC Library standards it declares), the Define-XML version list, and the declarable CDISC Library metadata products (R4 — optional, ordered, metadata only). Plan 2 (R1/R5): a run names packages, not a standard + version, so the former standards / families / defaultFamily fields are gone.

get.summary: Rule ids (with descriptions) and use cases for one rule package
get.description: The CORE rule ids in the named package (each with its description, for include/exclude selection) and any Use_Case tokens it defines. Empty when no such package exists.
All runs (most recently created first), or only those of a session when sessionId is given. Each row carries its owning session's current name.

get.summary: Get a check run's status and progress
get.description: With waitSeconds > 0, long-polls up to that many seconds (capped at 60) for the run to reach a terminal state before returning the current snapshot.

get.summary: Get the run-scoped source + expanded definition of one rule
get.description: { source, expanded } — source is the run's raw rule object, expanded is the synthetic generated rule that ran (null for non-generated rules). Either may be null; 404 when neither is found.

get.summary: Get a succeeded run's full JSON report
get.description: The assembled v1 report document (conformance + dataset details + rules + findings) — byte-identical to the CLI's report file.

409.description: Run did not succeed / not yet complete

get.summary: Get a succeeded run's v2 combined-finding JSON report
get.description: The v2 report: one object per finding (carrying its location plus its rows) instead of v1's per-row expansion — byte-identical to the CLI's --output-format json2 (.v2.json) file.

409.description: Run did not succeed / not yet complete

get.description: Files (name + size + SHA-256), the configuration, per-domain rules executed/total + findings, and any errors. Available for terminal runs that started (SUCCEEDED / FAILED / CANCELLED-after-start).

409.description: No execution log for this run

get.summary: Get a run's live execution-log lines
get.description: The run's log lines accumulated so far (INFO/WARN/DEBUG and any exception stack trace), from the given offset. Available while the run is RUNNING; poll with the returned nextFrom to stream new lines. The structured /log endpoint remains the complete view once the run is terminal.

get.summary: Download a run's raw execution-log file
get.description: The verbatim, pretty-printed log-<id>.json file, served as an attachment.

409.description: No execution log for this run

get.summary: Page through a run's findings, optionally scoped to a dataset and rule
get.description: Finding rows, optionally filtered to one file, domain and/or rule (core id). Used by the results drill-down to lazily load the findings of a specific rule in a specific dataset. Always reports the full matching total. Projected from the run's v2 combined-finding report, so each row also carries the EC-40 record key when the run resolved one; the fields are omitted entirely under the default corej.findingKeys=off.

get.summary: Get a run's results grouped by file then domain
get.description: Two-level grouping: each uploaded file (with size, modification date and SHA-256) contains its domains/datasets (with label, rows, columns), each carrying that domain's rule outcomes (incl. the per-rule violation count). Findings are not embedded — fetch them on demand, scoped and paged, via the findings endpoint.

get.summary: Get sizes + generation time of a run's downloadable artifacts
get.description: JSON report size, execution-log size (null if absent) and the run's finish time. The Excel report is rendered on demand, so it has no stored size.

delete.summary: Delete one staged file from a session
delete.description: Removes the file with the given bare name. Rejected (409) while any of the session's check runs are PENDING or RUNNING.

delete.summary: Delete a check run and its report
delete.description: Rejected (409) while the run is PENDING or RUNNING — cancel it first.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Optional parameters when creating a session

name.description: Optional human-readable session name (blank/null leaves it unnamed)

CreateSessionResponse.description: Identifier of a newly created upload session

sessionId.description: Opaque session id used in subsequent file/check calls

name.description: The session's display name, or null when unnamed

FileUploadResponse.description: Metadata of a file staged into a session

UrlUploadRequest.description: Stage a file into a session by URL

filename.description: Optional bare filename to store under

CheckRunRequest.description: Parameters for a check run over a session's staged files

defineXmlFilename.description: Name of an uploaded define.xml to use as metadata overlay (optional)

referenceDataFilenames.description: DEPRECATED — use 'datasetFilter' instead. Names of uploaded files to load as reference libraries (optional). A dataset the filter does not match is still loaded as reference data — visible to rules, never validated — which is what this field was for. Only formats a library supplier can open are accepted; any other format is rejected with 400 naming the file, its format and the supported list.

defineVersion.description: Explicit Define-XML version; null reads it from the library

includeRules.description: Include filter of CORE rule ids; when non-empty, only these rules run

excludeRules.description: Exclude filter of CORE rule ids; when non-empty, all but these rules run

rulesFilenames.description: Names of uploaded rule-package files to load in addition to bundled rules

datasetFilter.description: Restrict validation to these dataset/domain names; empty validates all

ruleThreads.description: Rule worker threads per dataset (>= 1); default 1

maxErrorsPerRule.description: Max findings to materialise per rule (per dataset); additional violations are counted but not listed. Null (the default) uses the service default (corej.engine.max-errors-per-rule / MAX_ERRORS_PER_RULE); <= 0 means unlimited.

metadataProducts.description: Ordered CDISC Library products consulted for metadata, highest precedence first (e.g. adam/adamig-1-3; a bare product id is accepted when unambiguous against the server's metadata cache). Selects METADATA only - rules are selected by 'rulesPackages'. Null or empty uses the standards the selected rule packages declare — and is therefore REQUIRED (400) when rules are selected only by 'rulesFilenames', since an uploaded rules file declares no standard.

severityThreshold.description: Weakest check level to evaluate: Reject, Error, Warning or Info. A rule's declared levels below it are not evaluated, and a rule with no level at or above it is skipped with a stated reason rather than passing silently. Null (the default) means Warning, so Reject+Error+Warning evaluate and Info does not. This is a RUN option only — no rule package and no rule may carry one. Notice is NOT a threshold — it is a report-only kind outside the ladder, authored by no rule.

rulesPackages.description: Rule packages to run, by short name (e.g. cdisc-adamig-1-3 for rules-cdisc-adamig-1-3.json). REQUIRED unless 'rulesFilenames' names uploaded rule files instead; the two are unioned. The selected packages declare the CDISC Library standards the run resolves metadata against, which is why this replaced the removed 'standard' and 'version' fields.

StartCheckResponse.description: Identifier of a newly started check run

checkRunId.description: Opaque check-run id used to poll status / findings

name.description: Display name; blank/null leaves the session unnamed

SessionFile.description: A file staged into a session

name.description: Display name, or null when unnamed

fileCount.description: Number of files staged in the session

files.description: The files staged in the session

DefineVersionResponse.description: Detected Define-XML version of a staged file

version.description: Short version label, e.g. 2.1; null if undeterminable

defineVersion.description: def:DefineVersion value, e.g. 2.1.0; matches the run form's define-version options; null if undeterminable

name.description: Short name to pass as rulesPackages, e.g. cdisc-sdtmig-3-4

ruleCount.description: Number of rules in the package

standards.description: CDISC Library product ids this package declares

RunOptions.description: Valid values for the run form

packages.description: Selectable rule packages, sorted by short name

metadataProducts.description: Declarable CDISC Library metadata products, as <group>/<product>

RuleOption.description: A CORE rule id and its description

RuleOptions.description: Rules and use cases for a standard + version

rules.description: CORE rules in the matching pack (id + description)

useCases.description: Use_Case tokens defined by the pack

CheckStatusResponse.description: Status and progress of a check run

sessionName.description: Owning session's display name, or null when unnamed/deleted

findingCount.description: Findings: the authoritative total once SUCCEEDED; while RUNNING, a running tally over the datasets finished so far; null otherwise

RuleReportRow.description: A rule's outcome in the run

DomainLogEntry.description: Execution stats for one validated domain

rulesTotal.description: Total rules available for the run (Y)

runtimeMillis.description: Dataset wall-clock validation time in ms (-1 = not measured)

ruleExecutions.description: Per-rule outcome of every rule run against this domain

FileManifestEntry.description: An uploaded file's name, size and hash

RuleErrorEntry.description: An error and the rule that produced it

RuleExecutionEntry.description: One rule's outcome against a dataset

coreId.description: Rule CORE id (expanded id for generated rules)

runtimeMillis.description: Execution runtime in ms for this rule on this dataset (-1 = not measured)

expandedFor.description: Variable a generated rule was expanded for (null otherwise)

notExecutedReason.description: Why the rule was not executed (null when EXECUTED)

description.description: Rule description (null when the rule carries none)

executability.description: Rule executability in title-case display form (null when none)

totalRuntimeSeconds.description: Total runtime in seconds (null if the run did not complete)

configuration.description: The configuration the run was started with

files.description: Manifest of the session's uploaded files

totalFindings.description: Total findings across all domains (null if the run did not complete)

failureMessage.description: Failure detail when the run failed

logLines.description: Run-relevant engine log lines (level-prefixed), in order

LiveLogResponse.description: A page of a run's live log lines

lines.description: Log lines from the requested offset, in order

nextFrom.description: Cursor to pass as 'from' on the next poll

terminal.description: Whether the run has reached a terminal state

usubjid.description: USUBJID of the affected record, if any

row.description: 1-based row number in the dataset, or null when not row-scoped

variables.description: Names of the variables reported for this row

values.description: Values of those variables for this row (positional)

domain.description: Domain / dataset name (disambiguates findings sharing a file)

keyVariables.description: Ordered record-key column names identifying this row, when resolved

keys.description: Record-key values for this row, keyed by column name

keySource.description: Which tier produced the record key: DEFINE_KEY, STRUCTURAL, NATURAL or SPONSOR_ID

total.description: Total finding rows for the run

firstIndex.description: Index of the first returned row

count.description: Number of rows in this page

items.description: The finding rows in this page

runtimeMillis.description: Dataset wall-clock validation time in ms (-1 = not measured)

FileGroup.description: One file and the domains it contains

version.description: Standard version display form, e.g. V3.4

libraryMetadataBasis.description: Library degradation note — present only when the CDISC Library could not be consulted for the run

dictionaryBasis.description: External-dictionary degradation note — present only when some dictionary rule in the run could not be answered; names what loaded (with versions), what did not and why, and the answerable count

reportBytes.description: JSON report size in bytes (null if absent)

reportV2Bytes.description: v2 combined-finding JSON report size in bytes (null if absent)

reportXlsxBytes.description: Pre-rendered XLSX report size in bytes (null if absent)

logBytes.description: Execution-log size in bytes (null if absent)

generatedAt.description: When the run finished / the artifacts were generated (ISO-8601)
